expectations.text: Identifies an API version bump silently reshaping event payloads that existing subscribers already store as the core failure.
expectations.evidence: Quotes the skill: 'An API version bump silently reshaping event payloads a subscriber already stores.'

expectations.text: Requires choosing exactly one schema-versioning camp deliberately, and warns against drifting into both by accident.
expectations.evidence: 'The skill requires picking one camp deliberately'; current approach called 'neither camp'.

expectations.text: Describes the first camp as pinning each webhook endpoint to an API version and rendering payloads per that version, attributed to Stripe.
expectations.evidence: 'Camp 1: pin each endpoint to an API version and render per that version (Stripe).'

expectations.text: Describes the second camp as versioning the event type itself, with a new type name per breaking change and additive-only evolution otherwise, attributed to Svix or Standard Webhooks.
expectations.evidence: 'Camp 2: version the event type, with additive-only evolution otherwise (Svix and Standard Webhooks).'

expectations.text: Identifies that the header-split envelope means the delivery log must capture headers as well as the body, or replay is unfaithful.
expectations.evidence: 'A delivery log that stores only the body while the envelope carries metadata in headers.'

expectations.text: Says the delivery log must be built to store headers from day one rather than retrofitted.
expectations.evidence: 'The skill says to build the log for this from day one.'

expectations.text: Raises thin payloads as a first-class alternative and states that a thin payload never changes shape when the API version bumps.
expectations.evidence: 'They remove this entire class of problem, because the notification never changes shape'.

expectations.text: States that thin payloads move the versioning question to the API call the consumer subsequently makes.
expectations.evidence: Not stated. It only says thin payloads remove the problem.

expectations.text: Cites the recommendation to keep payloads small, roughly under 20kb.
expectations.evidence: 'Stay under about 20kb.'

expectations.text: Offers the dual-run migration pattern for a full-to-thin move: emit both event flavors during the transition with a discriminator field so consumers can dual-run idempotently.
expectations.evidence: 'Stripe's dual-run pattern (emit both flavors with a discriminator field)'.

expectations.text: Recommends documenting the outbound events in the same OpenAPI document as the inbound API, using OpenAPI 3.1's webhooks section.
expectations.evidence: 'from the same OpenAPI 3.1 webhooks spec that drives delivery'.

expectations.text: Declines to recommend adopting CloudEvents unless the platform must interoperate with an event mesh that already speaks it.
